subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

I was told that we would met at five in the evening but no one has turned up for the meeting so far.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'we would met'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **'met'** is incorrect instead of this we need to use** 'meet'**
 
• According to grammar, whenever we use an auxiliary verb then we need to use a base form with it instead of any other form of the verb. In the given sentence, 'met' is a second form of the verb 'meet'.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He said he **would see** his brother tomorrow.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** *I was told that we **would meet** at five in the evening but no one has turned up for the meeting so far.*
